title: Compositional Grammar — Spell Deduction
description: Encodes HOW a spell's effect is deduced from its parts. The sigil provides the SUBSTANCE; each sign is an OPERATOR that transforms how that substance manifests. The deduction engine (src/engine/deduce.js) runs the operators through a pipeline and assembles a plain-language explanation. Derived from the canonical spells (see ANALYSIS.md §11).

model.principle: effect = substance(sigil) transformed by operators(signs), aimed by orientation/balance, scoped by target, scaled by power, stabilized by symmetry, negated by inversion.
notes: FORM is element-agnostic: column makes a beam of water (Watershot) OR light (Light Beam).
Exactly one of transmute/form usually dominates the primary clause; transmute outranks form.
Inversion flips an invertible operator's verb (crush↔reassemble, enlarge↔shrink, pull↔push).
Symmetry sets stability; size sets power; neatness sets duration.

interactions.text: Direction aims the bolts, firing them straight ahead at dangerous speed.
Bolts form but fly without a controlled aim — add a Direction sign to fire them straight.
Collection gathers the material that Billowing then converts into a cloud.
Billowing has no material to work with — add Collection signs so it has something to turn into cloud.
Convergence compacts the loose earth and sand into a solid, rigid form.
Radial tempers the flame into gentle, flameless warmth.
Vision + Eye + Bend meld the object — and whatever it covers — into the shadows (concealment).
On its own Vision only stirs light; pair it with Eye and Bend for true concealment.
Angle the Pull signs and the inflow twists into a vortex, spinning whatever it drags in.
Crush pulverizes on contact, but without a Column to drive it the break has little reach.
Window focuses Enlarge on the object the glyph is drawn on (it grows itself).
Diamond focuses Enlarge on nearby objects rather than the glyph's own surface.
With a wind element, Dancing Puppet sends objects darting through the open air.

power.tempered: weakened on purpose (Radial) — a gentle version of the element
power.focused: concentrated to a point (Convergence) — narrower but more intense
power.amplified: amplified by large or linked drawing
